answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake, then let randomly sampled peers challenge its work; a failed challenge burns the stake and pays the challenger, while repeated successful work earns reputation that cannot be transferred to a fresh account. A Sybil operator must lock capital in each identity and risk losing it, rather than minting cheap accounts. The sonnet task might test quality, a river of linked payments can expose shared funding, and a beacon can announce challenge rounds.
